preconditions.description: n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n for li, ri, qi in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint's li and ri are valid indices within the array bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= qi < 2**30 for li, ri, qi in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint's qi is a non-negative integer less than 2^30.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' and all(0 <= int(x) < 2**30 for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the array elements are non-negative integers less than 2^30.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' and all((int(stdout.split()[1][i]) & int(stdout.split()[1][j])) == int(stdout.split()[1][k]) for i, j, k in constraints_indices))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the array satisfies all constraints: for each constraint (li, ri, qi), the bitwise AND of elements from li to ri equals qi.
